caption: Ceramics quarter street, Grottaglie
composition: Whitewashed alley lined with majolica pottery displays under striped awnings · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The whitewashed street runs away at the center, its left side a riot of ceramics — shelves of painted plates, jugs, and bowls in blue, yellow, and ochre under a striped awning — with terracotta pots and green plants spilling along the paving. White houses close both sides, and a few figures stroll in the bright 14:31 sun. The stacked displays of maiolica pottery are the street's whole reason for being.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Grottaglie under afternoon light
